notes.title: PYTHIAN GETS ENHANCED FOR PCVR & PC
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support during our first steps on virtual grounds with the premiere of our Masters of Hardcore XR experience. As a festival organization we try to add an extra dimension to our brand experiences and are eager to keep on learning from the Steam community. 

Shift to higher quality visuals (PCVR & desktop only)
We have received a lot of feedback after our first event experience premiere and we took our time to fully absorb the feedback and upgrade Masters of Hardcore XR based on this. Our main challenge (already during the built) was the quality/look of the experience. As we decided to focus on being compatible for the Oculus store we needed to compromise a lot on quality levels because of the obvious disadvantages in hardware. Since then, we have come to the conclusion that PCVR is out home and place where our real fans (you guys) are. This brought us to the decision to shift our focus to higher quality for future experiences for PCVR en desktop only. This means that we are now able to use those RTX cards in your pc build and are able to bring much better visuals, lighting and environments. 

Changes in this update
We have started with enhancing everything we have built so far, so when you have done the update you are able to see the first changes. You will be able to go back to all scenes from the MOH event separately, and enjoy them in this enhanced mode. A quick note: Future updates are going to profit even more from this, since upscaling from low resolution textures & models is pretty hard!

We are very curious how you feel about this update and what you would like to see from us in the future. So don't hesitate to get in touch.

TL;DR > PYTHIAN GOT A VISUAL UPGRADE

notes.title: PYTHIAN LAUNCH PATCH 1.0
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support yesterday, we have received a lot of feedback and we know lots of areas where we can still improve the experience for all of you. We would like to emphasize two things: 
First -  PYTHIAN is best experienced in VR and we are still trying to find the correct way of transporting it to non-vr desktop use. If things can be improved, please reach out to us! 
Second – The Masters of Hardcore live experience is a very different experience compared to the throwbacks and we really want to emphasize that. So, if you have already bought the DLC for our premiere on the 27th of March, you will get a sneak preview of the first scene.

CHANGELOG
THE TERMINAL
NEW SNEAK PREVIEW OF MASTERS OF HARDCORE LIVE EXPERIENCE. When walking to the big Masters of Hardcore gate, you will either be greeted with a video explaining the event or a new preview of the first scene during Masters of Hardcore. This will only trigger when you have bought the Masters of Hardcore DLC.
Coming soon gates are now colliders.
Pillars in the Terminal are now colliders.
New mirror for group selfies.
Removed a wrong logo from the avatar select.

THROWBACK ROOMS
You can’t fall off the platforms when jumping and teleporting anymore.
If you however still manage to fall off, you will be teleported to the top of the map.
If the throwback is full (20pax), you’ll enter in single player mode.

MISC
You can now make (and RAISE) your fist.
Reduced the length of women's necks.
Removed a bug where the screen would go all white / flashing .
Raised music volume when having earplugs in.
3 different mute settings for talking / experiencing music
Indicator if person has earplugs /mute in.
Steam name indicator on chest.
Steam name indicator on back.

VR SPECIFIC
Smaller collider on hands so the lighting desk is easier to use
Teleport changed to walking with right, turning with left.
Teleport whilst jumping will not break your jumping ability

DESKTOP SPECIFIC
Fixed a bug which allowed to see through walls when walking against it
Walking through portals feels less glitchy now
ESC menu now has exit and resume buttons
More clear instructions at the controls station
Made the collider wall higher
